  <p class="sg-book-tagline"><em>From propositions to the real line, with remarks for economists</em></p>
  <p>The lecture notes of a first course in mathematical reasoning for master's students in quantitative economics: propositions and quantifiers, sets, mappings, relations and orders, the number systems, induction, liminf and limsup, cardinality. The course is organised around the notion of order.</p>
